title: smarthr-type
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: ONE original Japanese call-center recruitment HERO image, wide landscape aspect about 1938:811 (2.39:1). This is a new site-referenced creative direction, not a website screenshot or a clone.
Input image 1: actual saved website screenshot of SmartHR 採用, https://recruit.smarthr.co.jp/. Study its composition, type hierarchy and imagery treatment. Input image 2: our current call-center image, used ONLY for subject context (headsets, operators, call-center equipment), not its repeated anime arrangement.
Observed reference element: 画面を支配する極太文字、段差のある白い文字面、鮮やかな色面。大きな主張と短い補足の階層。
Direction: Translate the SmartHR recruitment screenshot's GIANT TYPOGRAPHY and stepped white headline planes into a call-center recruitment hero. Oversized heavy clean Japanese sans-serif text spans most of left and center on staggered white strips. RIGHT third is a cobalt/pale-blue flat visual area containing a tightly framed ORIGINAL photorealistic young Japanese headset operator and a small CRM monitor. Minimal, sharply structured, typographic advertising. No gradients, source slogans, fake performance metrics or source navigation. At least 60% of visual emphasis is typography; do not return the old anime group composition.
Exact ORIGINAL approved copy: small label "CALL CENTER RECRUIT"; headline "あなたの声を、" / "仕事にしよう。"; subcopy "人と話す仕事を、仲間と。". Use these strings ONLY, plus 電話対応 / 営業 / サポート / チーム if small work labels are needed. Do not copy any text from the attached website screenshot.
Keep call-center theme recognizable: professional communications headsets worn on heads with natural boom microphones, customer-contact workstation/screens with unreadable interface text, desk telephone or call-script papers. All human foreground staff Japanese adults. Natural proportions and coherent anatomy. Photographic concepts must be photographs; illustrative/sculptural concepts must follow their distinct direction.
Palette: mostly white, navy, cobalt blue and pale blue/teal, natural skin tones. The attached site's other brand colors are reference context, not output requirements. Keep bright edges that suit a white page, with no full dark rectangular background.
NO copied company logos, brands, slogans, named people, identity recreation, dates, certifications, customer quotes, salary/benefit promises, numerical claims, header/navigation, website CTA, browser chrome, watermarks or multiple concept thumbnails. No company-specific recruitment conditions. Preserve legibility, avoid cropped lettering or faces. Output exactly one finished opaque hero image, not a full page.

attached_images.role: Actual website screenshot; composition/type hierarchy reference

borrowed_visual_element: 画面を支配する極太文字、段差のある白い文字面、鮮やかな色面。大きな主張と短い補足の階層。

visual_inspection.headline: Exact approved Japanese headline complete/readable
visual_inspection.call_center: Foreground young Japanese operator wears boom-mic headset; background staff/CRM monitors and desk phone
visual_inspection.reference_derived_composition: Extreme heavy type on staggered white strips with blue field and large close-up operator on right
visual_inspection.issues: Blue field has mild tonal variation rather than completely flat solid color
